## Triage: first grade, `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:api` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). Conditional: measure the hosted route first; build only if it holds

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T09:03Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/spec` (`ApiErrorSchema`) plus the dispatcher's `errorFromThrown`, if the condition holds ⇒ `domain:spec`; rationale: every card that touches spec goes to the spec seat.

- **A source reading toward step 1, not the measurement.** objectstack-ai/cloud `apps/objectos/server/index.ts` (`main`):
  - it registers `createRestApiPlugin`;
  - it mounts `createHonoApp({ kernel, prefix: '/api/v1' })` **underneath** the plugin routes;
  - its own comment says "the plugin routes win the match against the dispatcher's catch-all `/api/v1/*` handler".

  So on that composition, a hosted `PUT /meta` likely meets `RestServer`'s door, which already carries `currentVersion` as data, and not the catch-all. Measure it on a hosted tenant before building: a stale `If-Match` save, then read which envelope answers. Tenant kernels go through the scoped dispatcher, so the reading must come from a tenant host.
- **If the catch-all is not reached:** close this card, as its step 3 says.
- **If it is:** `Clause-②: yes`. It is a declared envelope member, ⛔ not an `error.details` dialect (ADR-0112).

## `pm:queue` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer`: the one step left is a hosted-tenant reading no seat session can take

`domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `marchtian` · session `session_016njDy8ozy9B9Ns5Y8kAWEK` · 2026-10-10T08:19Z. Thread-read: 6056494314.

Maintainer-action: take one hosted-tenant reading — on a cloud tenant, save `PUT /api/v1/meta/<type>/<name>` with a stale `If-Match`, and record which envelope answers the `409`: `RestServer`'s flat `MetadataConflictErrorSchema` (it carries `currentVersion` as data) or the dispatcher catch-all's `{ success: false, error: { code, message, httpStatus } }` — done when that reading, with the cloud pin it was taken on, is posted on this card

- **The decision is already made** (triage `6056494314`): measure first. If the catch-all answers, build the `ApiErrorSchema` `currentVersion` member (`Clause-②: yes`) in `domain:spec`. If `RestServer` answers, close this card, as its step 3 says. Nothing here asks for a ruling.
- **Why no seat can do it:** the reading must come from a tenant host, because tenant kernels go through the scoped dispatcher. Spec-lane sessions reach neither a hosted tenant nor `objectstack-ai/cloud`. The previous seat-2 shift raised this in its maintainer chat, and nothing was recorded on this card. This comment records it.
- **The source reading triage already took** points to `RestServer`: `apps/objectos/server/index.ts` mounts `createHonoApp` beneath the plugin routes, and its comment says the plugin routes win the match. A `RestServer` answer closes the card with no code.
- **After the reading lands:** the director seat verifies it and removes the label, and the card goes back to `pm:queue` (catch-all) or closes `not_planned` (`RestServer`).

## Maintainer-action done: measured on a hosted environment. `PUT /meta` does not reach the `@objectstack/hono` catch-all, so step 3 applies and this card closes

Run by the maintainer's session `64cb68a6-01c7-4dc6-acc6-ccb459c90ef2` on the maintainer's instruction in chat, 2026-10-11 (「在托管环境上测一次 409」).

**Where it ran:**
- staging environment `os-4s63kc` (the maintainer's own acceptance environment);
- cloud build `d43ce896`, from `x-objectstack-build-sha` on `/health`;
- cloud's framework pin `.objectstack-sha` `56bf27af` (committed 2026-10-07). That pin predates both #22126 (`8f2e8081`, 34 commits later) and #22206 (`3aa0c7b5`, 76 commits later).

The caller was an environment admin session from the product's own SSO hand-off, using same-origin requests from the browser.

**The probe** used a scratch item made for it and deleted afterwards:

| step | request | answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/zz_probe_22222` | `404` (absent) |
| 2 | `PUT` with no `If-Match` | `200` `{success:true, version:"hmac-sha256:caaf…", seq:1, state:"active"}` |
| 3 | `PUT`, same body, `If-Match: "hmac-sha256:000…0"` (stale) | **`409`** `{"error":"dashboard/zz_probe_22222 has been modified since you loaded it. The version token sent is not the current version (current is hmac-sha256:caaf…).","code":"METADATA_CONFLICT"}` |
| 4 | `GET` | `200`, content unchanged |
| 5 | `PUT` with the current token | `200`, `seq` 1 (identical content, no new head) |
| 6 | `DELETE`, then `GET` | `200` `seq:2`, then `404` (cleaned up) |

**Which door answered.** Two independent signals point to `RestServer`'s door, not the dispatcher's catch-all:
1. **The `If-Match` was honoured.** At pin `56bf27af` the catch-all does not read `If-Match` at all; #22206 is what taught it, and #22206 is not in the pin. If the catch-all had answered, step 3 would have saved and answered `200`.
2. **The body is the flat `{ error, code }` dialect**, not the dispatcher's `{ success: false, error: { code, message, httpStatus } }`.

**Why this is structural, not an accident of the pin.**
- `apps/objectos/server/index.ts` (`ensureApp`) registers the plugin routes on the raw Hono app first. Only after that does it mount `createHonoApp({ kernel, prefix: '/api/v1' })` with `outer.route('/', inner)`. By Hono's registration order, the route-manager's `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` (`rest-route-ledger.ts:250`, still present on framework `main` `12b9daf7`) wins before the catch-all is consulted.
- `apps/cloud/server/index.ts` mounts the same way.

**Answer to the card's two questions:**
1. *Does the hosted runtime route `PUT /meta` to the catch-all?* **No.** It reaches `RestServer`'s door. Measured on staging at pin `56bf27af`. Production runs the same mount order, but it was not probed: no production write was made for this card.
2. *On which pin?* `56bf27af` today. When cloud's pin moves past #22126 (cloud#2709), the same door begins to carry `currentVersion` as data. That door is already the one hosted callers hit, so the version needs no new dispatcher-envelope member.

**Disposition:** step 3, "If it does not: close this card". The catch-all has no first-party caller for `PUT /meta` to serve. No `packages/spec` change is owed. Closing as not planned.

Side note, not a new card: at this pin the hosted 409 names the current version only in prose. That is the pre-#22126 REST body, and the pin move already queued on cloud#2709 resolves it.
